//: Copy to config.json and edit. Every key is optional; anything omitted uses the default shown here. Environment variables (VH_LANGUAGE and friends) override this file for a single command.
//prompt: Priming prompt, which MUST be written in the language above — it is what makes the recognizer produce punctuation. Leave null to use the built-in sample for your language.
//silencePeakDb: Recordings peaking below this (dBFS) are treated as having no signal and skipped instead of transcribed.
//numbering: How to read phone numbers written in local form. countryCode is the dialling code without '+', trunkPrefix is the domestic long-distance prefix ('' if your country has none), nsnLength is the number of digits in a subscriber number. US/Canada: 1, '', 10. UK: 44, '0', 10.
